title: Exact hyperbolic-tangent Gibbs kernel and capped local Dirichlet bound
question: Can the critical theta-half Gibbs difference be kept as an exact saturating transition kernel, giving a gap-free local bound that interpolates between a low-gap Dirichlet form and a high-gap variance cap?
promotion_boundary: R-373 is a finite algebraic and proxy-state checkpoint. It identifies an exact capped Gibbs transition kernel and checks its row bound on the actual-Q3 edge and square fixtures; it does not prove a uniform capped-Dirichlet estimate or global KMS transfer.
next_action: Prove a source-, volume- and cutoff-uniform estimate for the capped local Dirichlet form on a Hamiltonian-derived common core, using the low-gap/high-gap saturation split without assuming a uniform spectral gap.
boundary: Finite doubled-bond Gibbs proxy, all-prefix actual-Q3 edge and square rows, translated sites and selected bonds, both orientations, signs, adjoints and beta values. Capped-form uniformity, common core, common alpha, OS/KMS/GNS dynamics, gap, continuum, C6, Sector-A and Pre-A remain open.
